verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents its own retention and deletion controls for sandbox state. `hard_ttl` expiry durably requests deletion of identity and RootFS state, and the soft `ttl` triggers a pause. Users can choose whether the writable RootFS and process memory are preserved across checkpoints, and can manage persistent files without resuming compute. It does not document deletion or retention controls for snapshots, historical logs, the audit ledger, or account- and team-level data, so the story is only partly covered. missing for 10: explicit on-demand delete APIs for sandboxes/snapshots, retention settings for logs and the audit ledger, account/team data-deletion policy, independent corroboration
